fidelity: F2a — Two-Plateau 0D Electrochemical/Thevenin Hybrid + Polysulfide Shuttle + Thermal ODE
description: Physics-lumped 0D Li-S cell. Two-plateau OCV (high ~2.35 V S8->polysulfide, low ~2.1 V ->Li2S) + 1-RC Thevenin overpotential + Mikhaylik-Akridge lumped polysulfide-shuttle parasitic current (reduces coulombic efficiency < 1) + lumped thermal ODE. State = [SOC, V_rc, T]. solve_ivp time integration.
source: Mikhaylik & Akridge (2004), J. Electrochem. Soc. 151(11), A1969-A1976 (shuttle model); Wild et al. (2015), Energy Environ. Sci. 8, 3477; Kumaresan et al. (2008), J. Electrochem. Soc. 155(6), A576; Cuisinier et al. (2014), J. Phys. Chem. Lett. 5, 3227

unit.name: Generic Li-S pouch cell — Physics-Lumped Two-Plateau + Shuttle

capacity_ref.note: Nominal capacity at T_ref (practical ~600 mAh/g sulfur); reused from EC025 F1b

ocv_high_plateau.note: Upper plateau: S8 -> long-chain polysulfides (Li2S8/Li2S6/Li2S4), ~2.3-2.4 V vs Li/Li+ (Mikhaylik & Akridge 2004)

ocv_low_plateau.note: Lower plateau: short-chain polysulfides -> Li2S2/Li2S, ~2.1 V

ocv_high_frac.note: Fraction of capacity in the upper plateau (S8 contributes 1/4 of the 16-electron reaction)

ocv_top.note: OCV at SOC=1 (above upper plateau, sloping S8 region)

ocv_bottom.note: OCV at SOC=0 (deep Li2S, sloping tail)

ocv_sharpness.note: Logistic transition sharpness between the two plateaus

ocv_slope.note: Gentle slope within each plateau (sloped-plateau realism)

R0.note: Series (instantaneous) resistance at T_ref; Li-S higher than Li-ion due to poor S/Li2S conductivity

E_a.note: Arrhenius activation energy for resistance; polysulfide dissolution kinetics thermally activated (Mikhaylik & Akridge 2004)

dOCV_dT.note: POSITIVE entropic coefficient (+0.35 mV/K), unique to Li-S; Li+0.5S->0.5Li2S has positive dS, so discharge is reversibly endothermic (Kumaresan 2008; Cuisinier 2014)

k_shuttle.note: Mikhaylik-Akridge shuttle constant k_s; governs polysulfide-shuttle parasitic current. Higher k_s -> lower coulombic efficiency

f_high.note: Reduced amount of high-order polysulfide species (normalized); sets shuttle severity in the upper plateau

shuttle_act_E.note: Arrhenius activation energy of the shuttle constant; shuttle worsens at high T

hA_cool.note: Heat-transfer coefficient * surface area to ambient

current_A.note: Negative=charge, Positive=discharge; Li-S limited to ~2C by shuttle
